name: Business Day Convention 2 Code
definition: Specifies how a date is adjusted when it falls on a non-business day.

FWNG.name: Following
FWNG.definition: Date will be the first following day that is a business day.

MODF.name: Modified Following
MODF.definition: Date will be the first following day that is a business day unless that day falls in the next calendar month, in which case that date will be the first preceding day that is a business day.

NEAR.name: Nearest
NEAR.definition: Date will be the first preceding day that is a business day unless that day falls on a day other than a sunday or a monday, and will be the first following day that is a business day, if the relevant date otherwise falls on a Sunday or a Monday.

PREC.name: Preceding
PREC.definition: Non-business day will be adjusted to the first preceding day that is a business day.
